hero.title: VClaw — a Mac app that brings AI beside your daily online sales work.
hero.description: A desktop-first assistant with on-device AI: draft replies, pull structure from photos and chats, organize tasks, and track payments — your operational data stays under your control.
hero.channelsLine: Works with the channels you already use: Zalo, Messenger, Shopee, TikTok Shop, VietQR, GHTK…

summaryCards.title: AI on your machine
summaryCards.copy: Suggestions and processing run in the desktop app, reducing reliance on the cloud for sensitive workflows.

summaryCards.title: One focused cockpit

summaryCards.title: Fast to install
summaryCards.copy: A straightforward macOS installer so you can focus on selling, not DevOps.
